Explain cheese products, assist with sampling and purchasing, and answer product-related questions.
Explain cheese production process using models and energy stations, provide technical insights.
Assist visitors in using touch kiosks and digital content for enhanced engagement.
Facilitate career discussions, training sessions, and meetings in dedicated pods and training boards.
